cards.example_en: Every month the prisoner wrote a long letter to his family.
cards.example_zh: 那名囚犯每个月都给家人写一封长信。

cards.example_en: At the city concert hall, the young prodigy played the piano.
cards.example_zh: 在市音乐厅，那位年少的神童弹奏了钢琴。

cards.example_en: In a sentence, a pronoun can take the place of a name.
cards.example_zh: 在句子里，代词可以用来代替名字。

cards.example_en: Use a protractor to measure the angle in your maths book.
cards.example_zh: 用量角器量一量你数学书里的角。

cards.example_en: On the way to school, the child jumped over a deep puddle.
cards.example_zh: 在上学的路上，那个孩子跳过了一个深水坑。

cards.example_en: Suddenly a puff of wind blew the paper off the picnic table.
cards.example_zh: 突然一阵风把纸从野餐桌上吹走了。

cards.example_en: Farmers use a pump to draw water from the deep well.
cards.example_zh: 农民用泵从深井里抽水。

cards.example_en: On a cold autumn evening, we made pumpkin soup for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 在一个寒冷的秋夜，我们做了南瓜汤当晚餐。

cards.example_en: Whenever someone comes home, our puppy runs to the door.
cards.example_zh: 每当有人回家，我们的小狗就跑向门口。

cards.example_en: This city map puzzle has more than one hundred pieces.
cards.example_zh: 这幅城市地图拼图有一百多块。

cards.example_en: For many travellers, the pyramid in the desert is a famous sight.
cards.example_zh: 对许多旅行者来说，沙漠里的金字塔是一处著名景观。

cards.example_en: Ducks quack loudly when children throw bread into the pond.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们把面包扔进池塘时，鸭子会大声嘎嘎叫。

cards.example_en: Do not quarrel with your brother over such a small toy.
cards.example_zh: 不要为了这么一个小玩具和弟弟争吵。

cards.example_en: Students returned the health questionnaire before lunch today.
cards.example_zh: 学生们今天午饭前交回了健康问卷。

cards.example_en: Outside the stadium, a long queue formed before the big match.
cards.example_zh: 大赛开始前，体育场外排起了长队。

cards.example_en: Our history quiz is on Friday, so I am reviewing tonight.
cards.example_zh: 我们的历史小测验在星期五，所以我今晚在复习。

cards.example_en: I left my tennis racket in the club after practice yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天训练后，我把网球拍落在俱乐部了。

cards.example_en: We crossed the calm river on a wooden raft last summer.
cards.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘木筏渡过了平静的河。

cards.example_en: Bring a raincoat because the sky looks dark this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 今天下午天色阴沉，带上一件雨衣吧。

cards.example_en: As we left the park, a single raindrop fell on my hand.
cards.example_zh: 我们离开公园时，一滴雨落在了我的手上。

cards.example_en: She rarely eats sweets because she wants to stay healthy.
cards.example_zh: 她很少吃甜食，因为她想保持健康。

cards.example_en: Behind a bin, a rat hid after running across the street.
cards.example_zh: 一只老鼠跑过马路后，躲到了垃圾箱后面。

cards.example_en: If the front is full, please sit in the rear of the bus.
cards.example_zh: 如果前面坐满了，请坐到公共汽车的后部。

cards.example_en: The mirror showed a clear reflection of the desk lamp.
cards.example_zh: 镜子里清楚地映出了台灯的反射。

cards.example_en: She visits her grandparents regularly.
cards.example_zh: 她经常去看望祖父母。

cards.example_en: Sleep and test marks show a clear relation in our class.
cards.example_zh: 在我们班，睡眠和考试成绩呈现出明显的关系。

cards.example_en: Inside the museum hangs a reproduction of an ancient painting.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆里挂着一幅古画的复制品。

cards.example_en: Clean drinking water for the city comes from this reservoir.
cards.example_zh: 这座水库为城市提供洁净的饮用水。

cards.example_en: Evening revision helps me remember the words for Friday's test.
cards.example_zh: 晚上复习能帮我记住星期五测验要考的单词。

cards.example_en: Rex waits by the door until we come home from school.
cards.example_zh: 雷克斯在门口等着，直到我们放学回家。

cards.example_en: Around her mother's gift, she tied a bright red ribbon.
cards.example_zh: 她在给妈妈的礼物上系了一条鲜红的丝带。

cards.example_en: Outside the museum, the guard carried a rifle all evening.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆外面，卫兵整晚都持着步枪。

cards.example_en: Near our city, lions roar at night in the wildlife park.
cards.example_zh: 在我们城市附近的野生动物园里，狮子夜里会吼叫。

cards.example_en: Into the crowd the robber ran and dropped the stolen bag.
cards.example_zh: 强盗跑进人群，扔下了偷来的包。

cards.example_en: Within two days the police solved the robbery at the bank.
cards.example_zh: 警察在两天内破获了那起银行抢劫案。

cards.example_en: We did a role-play in which I acted as a shopkeeper.
cards.example_zh: 我们做了角色扮演，我扮演店主。

cards.example_en: The rough towel felt uncomfortable against my sunburn.
cards.example_zh: 粗糙的毛巾蹭在晒伤处，感觉很不舒服。

cards.example_en: Read the rubric carefully before you start the writing test.
cards.example_zh: 开始写作测验前，请仔细阅读题目说明。

cards.example_en: Before lunch the children built a sandcastle on the beach.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

cards.example_en: Heat the milk in a saucepan and then add the sugar.
cards.example_zh: 把牛奶放在煮锅里加热，然后再加糖。

cards.example_en: From the train window, the scenery looked green and peaceful.
cards.example_zh: 从火车窗口望去，风景翠绿而宁静。

cards.example_en: For our drive, we chose a scenic road through the hills.
cards.example_zh: 驾车出行时，我们选了一条穿过山丘的风景优美的路。

cards.example_en: Do not scratch the paint on the new desk in your room.
cards.example_zh: 不要刮花你房间里新书桌上的漆。

cards.example_en: When the thunder started, the little screamer ran to his mum.
cards.example_zh: 开始打雷时，那个尖叫的小孩跑向了妈妈。

cards.example_en: The drama club reprinted the script with fewer pages.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社重印了剧本，页数比以前少。

cards.example_en: At this harbour restaurant, fresh seafood is the special dish.
cards.example_zh: 在这家港口餐馆，新鲜海鲜是招牌菜。

cards.example_en: Our family spends every August at the seaside with friends.
cards.example_zh: 我们家每年八月都和朋友们在海滨度过。

cards.example_en: It is sensible to carry water when you hike in summer.
cards.example_zh: 夏天徒步时带上水是明智的。

cards.example_en: From many homes, sewage goes to a new cleaning plant in the city.
cards.example_zh: 许多家庭的污水被送到城里一座新的净化厂。

cards.example_en: In less than one hour, the shoemaker repaired both my boots.
cards.example_zh: 不到一个小时，鞋匠就把我的两只靴子修好了。

word.example_en: We discussed cost in relation to quality.
word.example_zh: 我们讨论了费用相对于质量的问题。
